data_cutoff.criterion: First promoted submission with official score at or below 50% of the paper's Google comparison score.

publication_policy.population_definition: Rows present in the pinned 27 July API response whose createdAt timestamp is on or before the final API update of the first promoted 50%-threshold crossing.
publication_policy.primary_result: The paper-admitted set preserves the six selected note-supported low-Q rows and includes all promoted Pareto points through the confirmed data cutoff. Broader API-metric and public-note-parser sets remain sensitivity calculations.

admission_policy.primary_rule: For the paper-admitted set, include promoted rows and the six rejected low-Q rows selected for the paper. This reproduces the paper's evidentiary choice but does not derive a general exclusion rule for every archived row.
admission_policy.deduplication: For duplicate Q,T coordinates, retain the earliest created row.
admission_policy.note_sensitivity_rule: Include promoted rows and rejected rows whose public note names all three evaluator channels and explicitly records a complete 9,024-instance run with zero classical, phase, and ancilla failures. Generic all-shots-OK prose is insufficient.
admission_policy.paper_admitted_rule: Include all promoted rows through the data cutoff and only the six rejected IDs selected for the paper, each of which has an explicit public 9,024-instance zero-failure note.
